'''Indar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Marauder]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Indar.jpg|250px|thumb|Erroneous female depiction of Indar]]
Indar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Indar spawned under the generic "rogue_marauder" template, resulting in him consistently appearing as a female Sanyassan. This contradicted [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]]'s [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue, who consistently referred to Indar as a male. This article assumes that Indar is [[canon]]ically a male in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that the female Sanyassan depiction is erroneous.<ref name="AED" />
